statement: Pinned Linux and SDL consumers place the common DS4 output flags and motor values at the same relative offsets in USB 0x05 and Bluetooth 0x11. In ID-excluded payloads the two validity bytes are at offsets 0/1 (USB) or 2/3 (Bluetooth); weak/right and strong/left unsigned 8-bit values are at 3/4 (USB) or 5/6 (Bluetooth). Bit 0 of the first validity byte enables motor updates; when clear, the motor bytes alone do not request a stop. Bluetooth has a two-byte prefix and a CRC32 over HID output prefix 0xA2, report ID and preceding payload, stored little-endian in the final four bytes.

applicability.revision: Linux 4056b3c and SDL 535d80b consumer implementations; retail revision unknown
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c:507-539,2332-2343,2365-2386; SDL_hidapi_ps4.c:924-973. Source-only field layout, enable and CRC convention; no physical run or physical intensity claim.
